2026 Q2 program, weekly call coaching (Colm Reyes, 2026-04-02): Kenji Yamada, Ben Kowalski, Jonah Weiss, Elin Larsson and Grace Park each get a weekly 1:1 call review with enablement through the quarter.
2026 Q2 program, new-hire shadowing (Colm Reyes, 2026-04-02): the five new AEs each shadow one of Chloe Mensah, Isla Tran, Ana Ruiz, Lena Moretti and Farid Nasser on live calls through the quarter.

2026 Q3 program, objection-handling workshop (Colm Reyes, 2026-07-01): the West pod (Ana Ruiz, Chloe Mensah, Elin Larsson, Grace Park, Isla Tran and Kenji Yamada) takes the four-session workshop in July; the East pod does not.

Play 7, call coaching (Colm Reyes, 2026-07-08): weekly 1:1 call coaching works. The five reps we coached in 2026 Q2 went from a 14% to a 25% win rate (+11 points). Every quarter, coach the five lowest win rates from the quarter before.

records.text: Play 8, objection-handling workshop (Ines Varga, 2026-10-06): the West pod took the workshop in 2026 Q3 and went from a 21% to a 28% win rate (+7 points) while the East pod, without it, held at 23%. Roll it out to East in Q4.
records.title: objection-handling workshop

records.advice: keep shadowers off the top five
records.text: Play 9, new-hire shadowing (Colm Reyes, 2026-07-08): carrying a shadower drags a closer down. The five reps who took a new hire on their calls in 2026 Q2 fell from a 31% to a 20% win rate (-11 points). Keep shadowers off our best closers; give new hires to mid-table reps.
